q-rowan-cinders.name: Cinders for the Lantern Walk
q-rowan-cinders.description: The Lantern Walk needs fresh parsnips to line the baskets. Bring five to Rowan at the plaza.

q-marisol-wagon.name: Wagon Repair
q-marisol-wagon.description: Marisol's wagon lost a wheel on the old road. Gather twenty pieces of wood for the repair.

q-finn-geode.name: The Hearth Geode
q-finn-geode.description: Finn wants a violet Amethyst to study the old hearth-light. The Lantern Wagon brings rare stones on Fridays.

q-bramble-delivery.name: Morning Delivery
q-bramble-delivery.description: Bramble owes Juniper a box of Hollow Chocolate. Deliver it to Juniper's door.

q-sable-message.name: Message to the Clinic
q-sable-message.description: Sable needs a message carried to Juniper at the clinic. Talk to Juniper.
